sources.title: chibifire/SkinTokens-GGUF-BF16 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: GGUF files of VAST-AI/SkinTokens with the checkpoint's BF16 matrices kept in BF16. 1-D and sensitive tensors are F32. The files are a format change of the released model. Nobody trained them again.
